essence: Cleansing may be performed with flour paste or with barley and similar substances derived from cow dung.
After cleansing, one should sprinkle with mantra and then apply the prescribed ash.
The ritual may be directed toward crowned kings or toward noble feudatories.
The teacher must accomplish the rite with no fewer than fifty.
In the intermediate case, the teacher should especially bathe them with those means.
